section_summary: This section documents procedures and applications governing entry, residence, and trade travel to occupied Japan during late 1947 under Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (SCAP) regulations. It includes official SCAP directives, notably Circular No. 8 on entry/exit controls for individuals, vessels, and aircraft, and Circular No. 12 on property, baggage, and commercial sample restrictions. The correspondence primarily addresses clearances, military permit issuances, and trade quota allocations for American, Allied, and neutral commercial representatives, journalists, and religious personnel.

subfiles.about: SCAP regulations governing entry and exit of individuals, surface vessels, and aircraft into and from Japan.

Defines administrative responsibilities of the Eighth Army, Naval Activities Japan, and Pacific Air Command, detailing passport, health, baggage, and quarantine requirements.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 8: Control of Entry and Exit of Individuals, Aircraft and Surface Vessels into and from Japan
